name: VR Phobia: Birds
summary:
# 🐦 One small step at a time
A pigeon coming closer. Wings flapping. Explore these encounters at your own pace in VR Phobia: Birds.

# 🥽 Why VR?
A sense of being there can prompt a real response, even in a virtual scene. VR lets you return to a situation, repeat it and choose when to go further.

# 🌱 Gradual practice
